_comment: Player-facing clue artifacts rendered in the Clue Browser (public/browser.html). These are the fake social media posts, profiles, and research papers a social engineer would 'find'. Abstraction ramps with difficulty: easy = direct, medium = less specific, hard = subtle with NO giveaway hints. Operator-only extra hints for hard accounts live in data/operator-notes.json (not served to players).

artifacts.body: My username is my hero name joined by an underscore: **captain_cyber**. In person I'm just a proud Texan! 🤠
My password is two words stuck together — a **Star** that gives a **Shield** — then the number **99** right after. ⭐🛡️99
My pet flies higher than anyone. It blasts off like it's headed to space! 🚀 Best buddy ever.
Born and raised in the home of NASA! 'Houston, we have a problem' hits different when it's your hometown. 🏙️
They call me 'prof' for short. Teaching the next generation about retro games! My handle is **prof** and **pixel** joined by a dot: **prof.pixel** 🕹️
My password: the number **8**, then the word **bit**, then the word **World** — all stuck together. Classic retro resolution! 🎮
Nothing beats my favorite arcade game — a yellow circle chomping dots and running from ghosts! 👻🟡
Throwback to my first school — Pixel Academy! Named after the tiny dots on a screen, just like me. 📺
I think in ones and zeros! My username is my first name and last name joined by an underscore: **betty_binary**. 0101
My password spells it out: the word **Zero**, then the digit **1**, then the word **One**, then the digit **0** — all together. 💾
My cat has a number name — it's the digit that isn't zero! The one between zero and two. 🐱
Favorite food is round, cheesy, comes in slices and has two Z's in its name. 🍕 Yum!
Out running again after dark. The night is when I feel most alive. 🌙
Mom's family name always made me think of a dark forest — a color and what trees are made of, together. 🌲
Grew up on a street named after a tree. I loved being the captain at the **helm** on that wooden playground.
Favorite color? Mix red and blue and you've got it. The color of royalty. 👑
Find me online under the handle on this profile. I fix the bugs nobody else can. 🐛🔧

artifacts.title: On the Elimination of Software Defects by Direct Compression
artifacts.abstract: My pet is named after the smallest unit of data made of eight bits — it sounds like something you do with your teeth. In this study we examine squashing bugs one at a time.

artifacts.title: Hereditary Keys: A Family History of Secret-Keeping
artifacts.abstract: My mother's family name joins the place where the dead are kept with a deep source of groundwater. Our lineage has guarded ciphers for generations across the Rocky range.

artifacts.title: A Decade in Review: Encryption Standards at the Turn of the 2010s
artifacts.abstract: Looking back on my graduating cohort at the very start of this decade — the year the tens began. The work encrypts a plea in its very title.

artifacts.abstract: I find the weak spot before anyone else does. My dog shares his name with what you build to take advantage of such a weakness. My handle writes 'vulnerable' the way the keyboard-number crowd would.

artifacts.abstract: My companion is the king of the dinosaurs — short arms, big teeth. I gave this fierce creature a soft, fluffy name you'd expect on a small hopping rabbit instead.
